name: Bookkeeper360
description: Bookkeeper360 provides bookkeeping, accounting, tax, payroll, advisory, back-office, and financial-insight services for businesses.
agentUseSummary: Bookkeeper360 cannot currently be connected as a Relay agent provider because it publishes no supported public customer-account API, delegated OAuth contract, customer API key, remote MCP service, webhook schema, or distributable operation contract. Its member portal synchronizes data inward from Xero, QuickBooks Online, Gusto, and other business systems and supports collaboration with a Bookkeeper360 team; those integrations do not grant Relay authority over Bookkeeper360 records. Relay will not reuse portal sessions, capture financial credentials, automate the app, or infer private endpoints.

blocked.label: Connect Bookkeeper360
blocked.description: Bookkeeper360 publishes no supported public OAuth, customer API key, remote MCP, webhook, or other delegated Bookkeeper360-account contract for Relay to implement.

blocked.label: Access accounting or financial data
blocked.description: Transactions, accounts, categorizations, books, reports, metrics, trends, cash flow, payroll analytics, files, tasks, meetings, messages, tax records, and company information are blocked without a supported authenticated API.

blocked.label: Perform bookkeeping, tax, payroll, or account actions
blocked.description: Account synchronization, categorization, goals, user changes, file requests or uploads, task changes, meetings, messages, bookkeeping, payroll, tax, payments, lending, and all other writes or submissions are blocked.

blocked.label: Use unsupported automation
blocked.description: Relay will not automate the Bookkeeper360 portal or apps, reuse browser sessions, capture Bookkeeper360 or financial-system credentials, accept invitation links, scrape reports, reverse-engineer private endpoints, or relabel inbound Xero, QuickBooks Online, or Gusto integrations as a Bookkeeper360 API.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported customer-authenticated Bookkeeper360 API or remote MCP contract with stable schemas and least-privilege authorization.

runtimeSupport.description: No customer-authenticated Bookkeeper360 operation is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No customer-authenticated Bookkeeper360 operation is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Bookkeeper360 documents an invitation-based member portal, web and mobile apps, human accounting teams, financial dashboards, files, tasks, meetings, messages, and inbound read-only synchronization from Xero, QuickBooks Online, Gusto, and other business systems. It publishes no generally available Bookkeeper360 account API, OAuth application contract, customer token, remote MCP service, webhook schema, stable operation schemas, sandbox, scopes, or revocation contract for independent third-party automation.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request Bookkeeper360 or financial credentials, publish runtime tools, accept portal invitations, or automate the Bookkeeper360 app. Reconsider only if Bookkeeper360 publishes a supported customer-authenticated API or remote MCP service with stable schemas, least-privilege read scopes, revocation, audit semantics, financial-data controls, and human confirmation for bookkeeping, tax, payroll, account, and financial actions.

evidence.supports: Bookkeeper360 describes a proprietary app that extracts data from QuickBooks Online, Xero, and optional Gusto integrations and provides dashboards, collaboration, file sharing, meetings, and tasks. It does not document a public Bookkeeper360 API or delegated authentication contract.

Bookkeeper360 documents customer-initiated Xero connection and read-only synchronization into Bookkeeper360. This grants Bookkeeper360 access to Xero data and does not grant Relay access to Bookkeeper360 records.

Bookkeeper360 app access is provisioned through customer invitations and email/password portal login. No public API credentials, OAuth scopes, token endpoint, webhook, or revocation flow are provided.

Bookkeeper360 markets financial dashboards, cash-flow and payroll analytics, AI-generated insights, messages, file requests, and meeting scheduling through its own web and mobile apps, not through a public external operation contract.

Bookkeeper360 licenses its platform for a member's internal use by authorized users and expressly restricts unauthorized access, modification, and reverse engineering. The agreement does not establish an API or delegated Relay authorization path.
